rules.title: Non-loopback TCP listeners require need and filtering review
rules.recommendation: Review every listed binding against the approved service inventory, business need and effective Firewall policy. Restrict unnecessary listeners through authorized administration. A local port number does not identify a protocol, prove remote access or establish a vulnerability; no connection or probe was performed.

rules.title: Non-loopback UDP bindings require need and filtering review
rules.recommendation: Review every listed UDP binding, approved application and intended interface against the effective filtering policy. UDP bindings do not imply a listening handshake or external reachability. Do not infer a service solely from its port number. Any configuration change requires authorized administration.

rules.title: Remote Desktop host is enabled: review necessity and access
rules.recommendation: Confirm the approved business need, allowed users and network restrictions with the administrator. Disable an unnecessary host through authorized administration; if needed, restrict access through a managed gateway or VPN and appropriate MFA. NLA does not prove MFA, and this reading does not prove external exposure.

rules.title: An enabled RDP host has a listener without required NLA
rules.recommendation: Review client compatibility and have an authorized administrator require Network Level Authentication for the listed listener. Review account authorization and MFA separately; no remote authentication test was performed.

rules.title: An enabled RDP host has a native-only transport policy
rules.recommendation: Review compatible TLS-based transport and server certificate deployment with the administrator. SecurityLayer=0 does not provide TLS server authentication. Negotiated TLS versions and certificate trust require separate validation; no certificate or connection was inspected.

rules.title: A native-only RDP policy accompanies low or client-compatible listener encryption
rules.recommendation: Review a High encryption baseline and TLS configuration with the administrator, accounting for supported clients. The native encryption level is configuration context, not the negotiated cipher or a claim that all TLS traffic is weak. FIPS is not required without an applicable organizational policy.

rules.title: Machine policy explicitly permits RDP password saving
rules.recommendation: Review whether Remote Desktop Connection may save passwords under the approved credential policy. Have an authorized administrator prohibit unnecessary password saving. User policies and existing saved credentials are outside this collection; an absent machine policy is not automatically a failure.

rules.title: Machine policy permits RDP files from unknown publishers
rules.recommendation: Review the need for unsigned RDP files and require trusted publishers where compatible with the approved workflow. This policy observation does not mean a malicious file was executed. User-level policy and saved connection files were not inspected.

rules.title: SMBv1 server protocol is enabled
rules.recommendation: Review legacy dependencies and migrate devices or applications to supported SMB. Have an authorized administrator remove or disable SMBv1 after compatibility review. Do not disable SMB2/3 or signing to work around compatibility. No exploitation or reachable share is inferred.

rules.title: SMBv1 client optional feature is enabled
rules.recommendation: Inventory and migrate dependencies on SMBv1 before authorized removal. Feature installation is distinct from driver availability, traffic negotiation and server configuration. Missing inventory is not evidence of disabled SMBv1.

rules.title: SMBv1 server optional feature is enabled
rules.recommendation: Review the legacy server component and business dependencies with the administrator before removing SMBv1. This observed feature state does not establish network reachability or an exploit.

rules.title: SMB client retains a dependency on the SMBv1 driver
rules.recommendation: Review the MRxSMB10 dependency together with the observed optional feature and driver Start setting. Plan migration and supported administrative removal; do not infer active SMBv1 traffic from a configured dependency alone.

rules.title: Defender antivirus is not enabled
rules.recommendation: Review the approved antivirus design and any replacement product before restoring Defender through authorized administration.

rules.title: Defender service is not active
rules.recommendation: Review the operating mode, approved replacement protection and service availability with the administrator.

rules.title: Real-time protection is inactive
rules.recommendation: Review authorized exceptions and restore the approved real-time protection configuration through the administrator.

rules.title: Behavior monitoring is inactive
rules.recommendation: Review the monitoring gap, operating mode and approved baseline with the administrator.

rules.title: On-access protection is inactive
rules.recommendation: Review the operating mode and approved protection policy before making an administrative change.

rules.title: Downloaded-file protection is inactive
rules.recommendation: Review coverage for downloaded files and the approved antivirus policy with the administrator.

rules.title: Defender network inspection is inactive
rules.recommendation: Review platform availability, operating mode and network inspection coverage. This reading is not a phishing test.

rules.title: Tamper protection is inactive
rules.recommendation: Review whether the exception is authorized and protect antivirus settings through the supported management channel.

rules.title: Defender reports outdated signatures
rules.recommendation: Review update connectivity, update source and signature health with the administrator; verify again after approved maintenance.

rules.title: Defender is not the active antivirus - review replacement coverage
rules.recommendation: Verify that the observed passive or EDR mode is intentional and that approved replacement antivirus protection is working. Do not enable competing antivirus products automatically.

rules.title: PUA blocking is not configured
rules.recommendation: Review approved software and exceptions; audit mode records events but does not block unwanted applications.

rules.title: Cloud-delivered protection is disabled
rules.recommendation: Review privacy, connectivity and approved cloud protection policy with the administrator.

rules.title: Network protection is not in blocking mode
rules.recommendation: Review applicability, connectivity and approved exceptions. Audit mode does not enforce blocking; no phishing verdict is inferred.

rules.title: Controlled folder access requires review
rules.recommendation: Assess ransomware exposure and application compatibility before choosing the approved folder protection policy; disabled or audit mode is a review warning, not proof of an incident.

rules.title: ASR rule is not in block mode - review applicability
rules.recommendation: Review this specific rule, operating-system applicability, application compatibility and approved exceptions. Audit/Warn or absence of blocking is not automatically a policy violation.

rules.title: Vulnerable signed driver ASR rule is not in block mode
rules.recommendation: Review applicability and approved exceptions for rule 56a863a9-875e-4185-98a7-b882c64b5ce5. This rule does not prove that vulnerable drivers were loaded or that exploitation occurred.

rules.title: Windows volume is not fully encrypted
rules.recommendation: Review sensitive data, conversion progress and the approved encryption policy; verify recovery arrangements before authorized administration.

rules.title: Windows volume protection is inactive
rules.recommendation: Review authorized suspension, maintenance and recovery arrangements with the administrator. No recovery keys are collected.

rules.title: Windows Update service is disabled
rules.recommendation: Review maintenance responsibilities and approved update policy. A stopped service with Manual start is not itself a failure.

rules.title: Windows Update reports a pending restart
rules.recommendation: Coordinate an approved restart and verify installed revision afterwards. A pending restart alone does not prove an exploitable missing patch.

rules.title: Domain: Firewall profile is disabled
rules.recommendation: Review the effective profile, approved exceptions and monitoring policy with the administrator. Changes must use the authorized management channel. This warning is contextual, not a compliance certification.

rules.title: MpsSvc service is stopped
rules.recommendation: Review the service state, effective Firewall policy and approved endpoint protection design with the administrator. No service is started or changed by WinSec.

rules.title: BFE service is stopped
rules.recommendation: Review the service state, effective Firewall policy and approved endpoint protection design with the administrator. No service is started or changed by WinSec.
